Dogecoin explorer documentation
Blocks, transactions and addresses

Search a block height, block hash, transaction ID, transparent Dogecoin address, or supported explorer URL. A 64-character hash may belong to several chains; manual chain selection stays available.

Dogecoin targets one block per minute, uses per-block DigiShield difficulty adjustment and supports Scrypt merged mining through AuxPoW. Since block 600,000 the block subsidy is 10,000 DOGE, with no further halvings.

1 DOGE = 100,000,000 koinu. Fee rates use koinu/B. Fiat values use the provider's Dogecoin prices and may lag the market.

Privacy and coverage

The explorer shows public Dogecoin transactions. Historical mining series and complete address indexing are not currently verified. Provider rate limits are separate from missing indexing capability.

The pending view reflects a node’s mempool; different nodes may see different transactions. Estimates are not confirmation guarantees.

Read-only API

Requests use the same local origin. Successful retained responses carry X-DOGE-Observed-At and X-DOGE-Stale headers. Provider failures return 503; absence returns 404. This local review does not broadcast transactions.

GET /api/blocks/tip/height
GET /api/block-height/100000
GET /api/block/100000/txs
GET /api/tx/19220173c151925d493a25dbe67798fa11e6e4db01b927b1c04cddead85d3d12
GET /api/address/DDogepartyxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxw1dfzr/txs
GET /api/address/:address/txs/chain/:last-confirmed-txid

Live updates: WebSocket /api/v1/ws with action init, followed by action want and data [blocks, stats, mempool-blocks].

doge.tx.taxi - Dogecoin block and mempool explorer
A tx.taxi explorer built from mempool/mempool
About doge.tx.taxi

doge.tx.taxi is the Dogecoin explorer in the tx.taxi multi-chain family. It preserves Mempool's proven interface for inspecting blocks, transactions, addresses, mining activity, fee estimates, and observed pending Dogecoin transactions while using a Dogecoin-specific tx.taxi identity.

Dogecoin-native data

Values are denominated in DOGE, koinu, or the selected fiat currency. Fee rates remain koinu/B, transaction sizes remain B or weight units, and all block, address, mining, concepts shown by the interface retain their Dogecoin meaning.

Provider coverage

Pending transactions are an observed sample, not a complete global mempool. Historical mining series and full address indexing remain unavailable from the current provider. Rate limits can temporarily prevent uncached data from loading.

Infrastructure

The explorer reads public Dogecoin network data through its configured backend. Explorer results are informational and can differ from another node's view of the mempool. Always verify payment details in your wallet and use your own node when independent verification matters.

Informational Explorer

doge.tx.taxi provides a view of public Dogecoin blocks, transactions, addresses, mining data, fee estimates, and mempool state. It is an informational service, not a wallet, exchange, custodian, payment processor, or transaction-priority service.



No Control Over Dogecoin Transactions

The operator cannot reverse, cancel, accelerate, recover, or redirect a Dogecoin transaction. For wallet, exchange, or payment issues, contact the service that created or received the transaction.



Data and Availability

Explorer data may be delayed, incomplete, unavailable, or different from another node's view. Fee estimates are estimates only and do not guarantee confirmation. The service is provided as-is without a promise of uninterrupted availability or fitness for a particular purpose.



Acceptable Use

Do not abuse the website or API, interfere with service operation, bypass reasonable rate limits, or use the service unlawfully. Access may be limited when necessary to protect availability.



External Services

This site may link to tx.taxi contact channels, Dogecoin references, upstream source code, and infrastructure dependencies. External websites have their own terms and policies.



Open Source

doge.tx.taxi is derived from mempool/mempool. Contact t.me/hiss for the current reviewed fork source package.

Privacy Policy
Updated: September 20, 2026



Use Your Own Node When Privacy Matters

doge.tx.taxi displays public Dogecoin chain and mempool data through the backend configured by the site operator. For independent verification and the strongest network privacy, use your own Dogecoin node and explorer.



Request Data

Normal website and API requests can reveal standard web metadata to the operator, including your IP address, user agent, requested URL, and request time. Server logs may be retained for reliability, abuse prevention, and debugging.



Local Preferences

Display preferences such as theme, denomination, fiat currency, language, and timezone may be stored in your browser. doge.tx.taxi does not require an account for ordinary explorer use.



Public Blockchain Data

Dogecoin transactions, addresses, scripts, and blocks are public. Looking up an address or transaction can associate that lookup with your network metadata. Do not treat a public explorer as a privacy boundary.



External Links

This site links to tx.taxi contact channels, Dogecoin documentation, and upstream source code. Those external services have their own privacy policies.



Open Source Attribution

Mempool names, logos, and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners; doge.tx.taxi is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mempool Holdings S.A. de C.V.

tx.taxi Identity

doge.tx.taxi is an independently operated Dogecoin explorer in the tx.taxi family. Its domain, wordmark, chain palette, and service identity distinguish this fork from the upstream project.



Upstream Attribution

This software is derived from The Mempool Open Source Project. The upstream source code, visual system, project names, logos, and trademarks belong to their respective owners.



No Affiliation

doge.tx.taxi is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Mempool Holdings S.A. de C.V. References to mempool.space and mempool/mempool are nominative attribution to the software from which this fork derives.



Dogecoin

Dogecoin is an open network and protocol. References to Dogecoin, DOGE, koinu, blocks, transactions, addresses, and merged mining describe the network data presented by this explorer.
